description.zh: 软件工程工作流：站会、代码评审、架构决策、事故响应、调试与技术文档。所有技能可独立使用，连接源码管理 / 项目跟踪 / 监控类连接器后体验更佳。
description.en: Software engineering workflows: standups, code review, architecture decisions, incident response, debugging, and technical documentation. Works standalone; richer with source-control, tracker, and monitoring connectors.

welcome_message.zh: 从代码评审到事故响应，把工程流程交给我
welcome_message.en: From code review to incident response — hand me your engineering workflows

zh: 帮我评审这段改动，重点关注安全、性能与边界情况
支付服务出现大量 503，按事故响应流程帮我处理：分级、沟通、缓解与复盘
服务间要不要引入消息队列？帮我写一份带权衡分析的架构决策记录
en: Review this change with a focus on security, performance, and edge cases
The payments service is throwing 503s — run the incident workflow: triage, communicate, mitigate, and postmortem
Should we add a message queue between services? Draft an architecture decision record with trade-offs
